body:
HOLD (Fable2, 2026-11-27 15:26Z, Opus2 #8265/#8266). All TermAl FULL gates on EVERY host are held until P0 w-da332f6df745 lands. The test terminal_run_route_proxies_valid_remote_multibyte_commands configures an enabled SSH remote (example.com:22, alice) on loopback. If its /api/health probe fails or times out, ensure_available (src/remote.rs ~1139-1167) calls start_process, which runs the system ssh. Under Greg's absolute ssh ban, an agent-launched FULL that can run ssh isn't allowed.
- Focused runs that demonstrably exclude the test or module may continue.
- No filtered "full" gate.
- w-da33's fix candidate's own FULL runs UNFILTERED, because the candidate removes the path by construction. The pair must first confirm (a) an injected non-network starter for ALL tests reaching start_process with an enabled remote, all audited, and (b) a behavioural test that a failed probe never spawns ssh.
- After it lands: w-1f9d R2, then ee06's Windows FULL, then the rest.
- Greg was informed (Asistant #2953).
Lift this hold when w-da33 lands.

UPDATE 15:46Z (round 1 Codex review, Opus2 #8274): the Git push fixtures (src/tests/git.rs:1884/:1934) can also reach Git's own ssh through inherited transport configuration. Focused runs on any commit other than w-da33's fix candidate must now exclude BOTH remote_terminal AND tests::git::. w-da33's scope includes a harness-level, fail-closed Git transport (no ssh/ext, independent of user Git config). The failed-probe witness must be unambiguous, not a shared 502.

UPDATE 15:50Z: ACTUAL ssh launches were confirmed in two older WinB focused runs (test-cf2e07b1 on 419e7385, test-ea33a7b5 on 6f682e8d), both "ssh: Could not resolve hostname build.example", from the "Build host" fixture in src/tests/engram_overlap_cause.rs. Focused runs on other commits must now exclude remote_terminal, tests::git:: AND tests::engram_overlap_cause. w-da33's scope covers every SSH-remote fixture through a harness-level fail-closed starter. Both logs are kept as evidence until w-da33 closes. Greg was told plainly (Asistant #2956).

FILTER CORRECTION (Opus2 #8281): on master the overlap_cause tests are mounted as tests::engram_host_adapter::turn_checks::carried_checks::overlap_cause:: (file src/tests/engram_overlap_cause.rs), so the exact skip flags sent to all runners and owners are `--skip remote_terminal --skip tests::git:: --skip overlap_cause`. On master that file has no build.example, but it sets remote_id 'ssh-test' (line 148), so w-da33's audit covers it. The build.example fixture exists only on the unlanded commits 419e7385 and 6f682e8d.
